from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into the in-memory config buffer that the parser will read."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":768,"var":"config->parser.lexer.pos/end","code":"config_init_data(config, data, len);","note":"The fuzz buffer becomes the lexer input range, so every byte in the PoC can influence tokenization."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":430,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '$' && peek(lexer) == '{') return lex_variable;","note":"A '$' followed by '{' diverts the lexer into variable parsing, creating a path that uses lookahead and backup."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"peek","line":268,"var":"chr","code":"int chr = next(lexer); backup(lexer);","note":"peek() reads one byte past the current position and then rewinds, so it depends on the lexer being able to safely inspect the next byte."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"backup","line":279,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"lexer->pos--; if (*lexer->pos == '\\n') lexer->cur_line--;","note":"backup() decrements the cursor unconditionally; when the lexer is already at the start of the mapped buffer, this underflows to memory before the input."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_error","line":301,"var":"LEXEME_ERROR","code":"return lex_error(lexer, \"Invalid character\");","note":"Malformed input can force the lexer into the error path, which still emits a lexeme and continues parser state transitions."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_config","line":674,"var":"lexeme->type","code":"default: lwan_status_error(\"Unexpected lexeme type: %s\", lexeme_type_str[lexeme->type]);","note":"The parser consumes the lexer output and reports the malformed token stream; the crash hypothesis remains the boundary rewind in backup()/peek() when the input begins with '$' or ends immediately after a variable opener."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
